# Instituto Internacional (IIE)

> > American institute in Madrid offering English language courses, American Cultural Studies programs, and digital pedagogy resources through their Campus IIE learning platform.

The International Institute (Instituto Internacional) is an American cultural and educational institution based in Madrid, Spain. It provides English language instruction for adults and young learners, hosts cultural events and conferences, and maintains a digital learning management system for course delivery.

## Key Topics

- English language learning (adult & young learners)
- American Cultural Studies courses
- Campus IIE learning management system
- Instituto Americano Madrid
- Digital literacy and pedagogy
- Teacher professional development
- American Space Madrid events
- Library and biblioteca resources
- Course catalog by academic year
- Student life and institute experience
- Cultural programming (Unamuno series, film screenings)
- 21st century teaching methodologies

## Main Platform & Course Catalog

- [Instituto Internacional Homepage](https://iie.es): Main website for the American institute offering English courses in Madrid
- [Campus IIE](https://campus.iie.es): Learning management system with English courses for adults and young learners
- [Course Categories](https://campus.iie.es/course/index.php): Browse complete course catalog organized by academic year and student type

## Professional Development & Pedagogy

- [Inspiring Change Conference](https://iie.es/en/inspiring-change): Conference on 21st century teaching methods, new pedagogies, and digital literacy in the creative classroom

## American Cultural Studies & Events

- [Winter 2026 ACS Courses](https://iie.es/2025/11/27/new-acs-course-winter-2026-the-great-american-novel-the-moviegoer): Announcement of three new American Cultural Studies courses including The Great American Novel and The Moviegoer
- [Unamuno Author Festival Film Screening](https://iie.es/event/unamuno-author-festival-film-screening): Documentary screening 'Voices Beyond the Wall' at American Space Madrid
- [Juneteenth History](https://iie.es/2024/06/19/la-historia-del-juneteenth-dia-festivo-en-estados-unidos): Article exploring the history and significance of Juneteenth as a US federal holiday

## Student Life & Blog

- [A Day in the Life at IIE](https://iie.es/2025/03/19/a-day-in-the-life-of-the-international-institute): Behind-the-scenes look at daily classes, activities, and student experience at the International Institute
